mapper.insert: INSERT INTO annotation_task_orders (application_id, schedule_id, worker_id, job_id, status, items_completed, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{jobScheduleId}, #{workerId}, #{jobId}, #{status}, #{completedItems}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE annotation_task_orders SET status = #{status}, items_completed = #{completedItems}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM annotation_task_orders WHERE worker_id = #{workerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM annotation_task_orders WHERE job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
